title: Guided onboarding: feature flag + cohort targeting (new orgs, % rollout, allowlist) + admin override
creator: Dylan Brooks
description:
We need controlled rollout for the new in-Console Guided Onboarding Checklist (Phase 1: Hosted API). Implement cohort targeting so we can:

1) Enable for *new orgs only* (default for beta)
2) Gradually increase exposure via random % rollout
3) Allowlist specific orgs for qualitative beta + Support escalations
4) Provide an internal admin override for troubleshooting / demos / resetting access

Scope
- Flag evaluation must be server-authoritative (no client-only gating as source of truth).
- Console should receive a single response (enabled + reason) and render checklist routes/components accordingly.
- Config should be changeable without redeploy.

Out of scope
- Full experimentation framework (A/B variants per step ordering/copy). We only need ON/OFF gating and cohort selection.
- Dedicated/Private onboarding rollouts.

Proposed flag
- Name: console.guided_onboarding_checklist.v1
- Primary unit: org_id (not user_id) to keep experience consistent within an org.

Targeting rules (priority order)
1. Admin override (force_on / force_off) per org_id
2. Allowlist per org_id (force_on) + optional denylist (force_off)
3. New-orgs-only gate: org.created_at >= rollout_start_date (config)
4. Percentage rollout: deterministic hash(org_id) < rollout_percent

Notes
- If new-orgs-only is enabled, existing orgs should not receive the checklist unless allowlisted or admin-forced.
- We should return a reason code for debugging (e.g., ADMIN_FORCED_ON, ALLOWLIST, NEW_ORG_PERCENT, PERCENT_ROLLOUT, DEFAULT_OFF).

Acceptance criteria
- [x] Backend endpoint returns evaluated state for console.guided_onboarding_checklist.v1 for the requesting org, including a stable reason code.
- [x] Deterministic percentage rollout by org_id (consistent across sessions/regions).
- [x] Config supports: rollout_percent (0–100), rollout_start_date, new_orgs_only (bool), allowlist (org_ids), denylist (org_ids).
- [x] Admin override is persisted and takes precedence over all other rules.
- [x] Admin override is auditable (who/when/what). At minimum: audit log entry with actor_user_id + org_id + old_value/new_value.
- [x] Unit tests for evaluator precedence and edge cases (org missing created_at; config empty; allowlist + denylist collisions).
- [x] Console uses backend-evaluated flag to show/hide checklist entry points (no “flash of checklist” for disabled orgs).
- [x] Rollback path documented (set rollout_percent=0 and/or force_off denylist for impacted orgs).

Implementation plan
1) Add flag evaluator in Console backend (FeatureFlags service layer)
   - Inputs: org_id, org_created_at
   - Config source: existing server-side dynamic config store (same used for Console gradual rollouts)
   - Output: enabled: boolean + reason: string + config_version: string

2) Expose minimal endpoint to Console UI
   - Prefer piggybacking on existing bootstrap/session payload (org context endpoint) to avoid extra round trip.

3) Admin override
   - Add internal-only endpoint: POST /internal/orgs/{orgId}/feature-flags/console.guided_onboarding_checklist.v1
   - Values: force_on | force_off | clear
   - Permissions: internal admin role only
   - Write audit entry

4) Console integration
   - Gate checklist routes + navigation card on evaluated flag.
   - Keep feature-flag evaluation centralized; do not re-implement targeting in client.

5) Telemetry
   - Log evaluation reason server-side (structured log) to help debug cohort issues.
   - No user-facing analytics requirement in this ticket; onboarding events are handled in ENG-23112.

Risks / edge cases
- Newly created orgs with missing org.created_at in some legacy paths: treat as existing org (fail closed) unless allowlisted/admin-forced.
- Multi-region consistency: percentage rollout must be deterministic and not depend on in-memory state.
- Allowlist/denylist precedence: denylist should win over allowlist unless admin override is set (explicit force_on/force_off always wins).

Links
- PRD: sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/guided-onboarding-checklist-prd-2026-01.json
- UX spec: sources/confluence/product-docs/design-specs/console-guided-onboarding-ux-spec-2026-01.json
- Runbook (rollout/rollback): sources/confluence/eng-platform/runbooks/console-checklist-feature-flag-rollout.json

Ship vehicle
- GitHub PR should include: evaluator + config schema + internal admin endpoint + basic tests.
